detail.shortDesc: A complete all-in-one beauty kit designed for makeup, skincare, and personal grooming. This travel-friendly set includes makeup brushes, beauty blenders, puffs, an eyelash curler, hairband, wrist cuffs, and a spacious wash bag.
detail.description:
Keep all your beauty essentials organized with this Multipurpose Travel Beauty Kit. The set comes with a stylish, spacious wash bag and a variety of makeup and skincare accessories. From applying foundation and blending makeup to cleansing your face and keeping your hair away during your routine, this kit has everything you need in one convenient package.

Key Features:

  1. Complete all-in-one beauty and travel kit
  2. Soft and skin-friendly accessories
  3. Premium synthetic makeup brushes
  4. Multiple beauty blenders and makeup puffs
  5. Eyelash curler for easy lash styling
  6. Bow-style hairband keeps hair away from the face
  7. Wrist cuffs help prevent water from running down your arms
  8. Spacious and travel-friendly wash bag
  9. Great for everyday makeup, skincare, and travel
  10. Ideal as a gift for makeup and beauty lovers
